## Summary

## Context

## Approach

## Scope

- [ ] One planned step, sized with Fibonacci points: 1 / 2 / 3 / 5 / 8
- [ ] If this was estimated at 13 points or more, it has been split into smaller tasks
- [ ] An 8-point scope is indivisible and cannot be split further

## Accessibility and behavior

What keyboard, screen reader, reduced-motion, responsive, or other user-impact checks apply?

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. For important behavior, note whether tests were written first. Keep unit tests focused on functionality whose failure would break the overall experience. Do not introduce snapshot tests before the first MVP launch; after launch, use them only when the client strongly values visual regression coverage. If no checks apply, say why.

## Risks and rollout

Note risks, migration needs, rollout, or follow-up. Use `Not applicable` with a reason when appropriate.
